title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out
content: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines, following a wave of early corporate pushback to the Intercontinental Exchange and OKX joint venture.

title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
content: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.

title: Google’s AI chip push adds more pressure on Nvidia
content: Google’s specialised AI chips threaten greater competition as Nvidia faces a leadership investigation.

title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from $6.3 billion Binance hack
content: North Korean hackers used six homemade memecoins to launder 117,000 NEAR, worth about $430,000, from the $6.3 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says.

title: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks amid Wall Street's blockchain race
content: Avalanche will serve as the core settlement ledger for the exchange's planned blockchain stock market

title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
content: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Should you leave Australia to avoid paying 47% tax on crypto gains?
content: Some Australian crypto investors are moving overseas to avoid the huge CGT increase from July 2027. But there are also less drastic ways you can pay less tax.

title: North Korean hackers create memecoins to launder funds from Binance hack: Elliptic
content: The blockchain firm traced stolen funds through six new tokens on NEAR, where hackers used liquidity pools to obscure transfers between wallets.

title: Formation Securities plans Solana stock trading venue under SEC exemption
content: The proposed venue would offer 24/7 trading of tokenized shares from Galaxy Digital, Exodus and Forward Industries, with a launch planned for early 2027.

title: Mercado Bitcoin begins post-hack reopening without a timeline for withdrawals
content: Customers can view their pre-hack balances as access returns in phases. The exchange has yet to say when withdrawals will resume.

title: Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide
content: Bitcoin Magazine Amundi Boosts Strategy (MSTR) Stake 44% to $291 Million as Shares Slide Europe's largest asset manager raised its Strategy holding to 1.9 million shares in the third quarter, a 13F shows, even as MSTR has since fallen about 18% from quarter-end. title: Elizabeth Warren Plans Prediction Market Crackdown as She Prepares to Chair Senate Banking
content: Bitcoin Magazine Elizabeth Warren Plans Prediction Market Crackdown as She Prepares to Chair Senate Banking A Warren banking aide says the incoming Senate Banking chair will target prediction markets' "Wild West-style lack of oversight," after she and Sen. John Curtis pressed Kalshi and Polymarket on election trading. title: North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot
content: Bitcoin Magazine North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot Elliptic says North Korean launderers created six throwaway meme tokens on NEAR between Nov. 5 and 7, moving about $430,000 of stolen Binance funds through homemade liquidity pools. This post North Korea Is Minting Its Own Meme Coins to Launder Binance Hack Loot first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

title: TD Cowen Gives Stablecoin Yield Ban 10% Odds as Banks Plan Push in Democrat-Led Congress
content: Bitcoin Magazine TD Cowen Gives Stablecoin Yield Ban 10% Odds as Banks Plan Push in Democrat-Led Congress TD Cowen's Jaret Seiberg puts only a 10% chance on a congressional ban on platform stablecoin yield over the next two years, even as banks renew their push after Democratic midterm wins. title: BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT
content: Bitcoin Magazine BlackRock: Security Fears Are Driving Bitcoin Whales Into IBIT BlackRock's Robbie Mitchnick told Barron's demand to swap directly held bitcoin for IBIT shares is at its highest yet, with "security and peace of mind" the top reason as kidnappings and hacks rise.
